name: Nilesh Kakatkar
summary: Go backend developer with nearly 2 years of experience on CACHATTO One (C1), a hybrid-work platform that gives enterprises secure, VPN-free remote access to cloud and on-premises resources. I build the platform's multi-tenant core, high availability, WireGuard networking, real-time remote management, and Android device management.

experience.product: C1 (CACHATTO One): hybrid-work platform for secure, VPN-free remote access to cloud and on-premises resources

items.title: Multi-Tenant Platform
items.text: Helped migrate C1 from single-tenant to a centralized multi-tenant architecture, with customer-side connectors that give secure access to private network resources.

items.title: Remote Management (RMM)
items.text: Built the WebSocket relay for agent-client communication, covering agent registration, authentication, and session management; began moving to WebRTC peer-to-peer.

items.title: Android MDM
items.text: Implemented Android device management with the Android Management API: enrolment, policy management, Pub/Sub event handling, and device-specific configurations.

items.title: High Availability
items.text: Implemented primary-standby HA with database replication, failover/promotion, and node synchronization to keep C1 available during failures.

items.title: WireGuard Networking
items.text: Replaced script-based WireGuard management with a native Go implementation for interfaces, peers, routing, and tunnel lifecycle.

items.title: Architecture & Quality
items.text: Helped move C1 from a tightly to a loosely coupled design, added unit tests, and supported CI/CD adoption for automated builds and validation.

projects.name: Go Shield
projects.subtitle: L7 Reverse Proxy & Load Balancer
projects.text: Built an L7 reverse proxy and load balancer with SSL termination, rate limiting, dynamic backend registration/removal, and Redis-backed configuration/state management.

projects.name: ShopCore
projects.subtitle: Microservices E-Commerce Platform
projects.text: Built a microservices-based e-commerce platform using gRPC for service communication, Kafka for asynchronous messaging, and database-backed services for core operations.

education.school: Jain College of Engineering and Research, Belgaum

intro: I build the backend systems behind secure remote access: multi-tenant cores, high availability, WireGuard tunnels and real-time device management.
